# SYNESIS_E039 — Error

## Description

Field `field_name` listed in `ITEM FIELDS` without a FIELD definition.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The field 'field_name' is listed in `ITEM FIELDS`,
  but there is no matching `FIELD` definition in the template.
  Add to the template:
      FIELD field_name TYPE TEXT
          SCOPE ITEM
      END FIELD
  This problem is in the template definition. If you are not the author
  of the template, tell the project coordinator.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **UndefinedFieldInScopeFields**: `field_name`, `scope`
